description.value: Mary Brown's is a 100% Canadian-owned fried chicken chain operating since 1969, known for hand-cut, hand-breaded chicken prepared fresh in each store using Canadian-sourced whole birds and locally grown potatoes. The Maple Ridge location offers takeout and delivery of signature chicken, hand-cut taters, and handmade coleslaw. It is a convenient hot-meal stop for cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley corridor.
